en.text: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

zhSimplified.text: 无能的人蒙你何等的帮助！ 膀臂无力的人蒙你何等的拯救！

zhTraditional.text: 無能的人蒙你何等的幫助！ 膀臂無力的人蒙你何等的拯救！

en.text: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

zhSimplified.text: 无智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！ 你向他多显大知识！

zhTraditional.text: 無智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！ 你向他多顯大知識！

en.text: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

zhSimplified.text: 你向谁发出言语来？ 谁的灵从你而出？

zhTraditional.text: 你向誰發出言語來？ 誰的靈從你而出？

en.text: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

zhSimplified.text: 在大水和水族以下的阴魂战兢。

zhTraditional.text: 在大水和水族以下的陰魂戰兢。

en.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

footnotes.text: 26:6 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 在 神面前，阴间显露； 灭亡也不得遮掩。

zhTraditional.text: 在上帝面前，陰間顯露； 滅亡也不得遮掩。

en.text: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 神将北极铺在空中， 将大地悬在虚空；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝將北極鋪在空中， 將大地懸在虛空；

en.text: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

zhSimplified.text: 将水包在密云中， 云却不破裂；

zhTraditional.text: 將水包在密雲中， 雲卻不破裂；

en.text: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

zhSimplified.text: 遮蔽他的宝座， 将云铺在其上；

zhTraditional.text: 遮蔽他的寶座， 將雲鋪在其上；

en.text: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 在水面的周围划出界限， 直到光明黑暗的交界。

zhTraditional.text: 在水面的周圍劃出界限， 直到光明黑暗的交界。

en.text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

zhSimplified.text: 天的柱子因他的斥责震动惊奇。

zhTraditional.text: 天的柱子因他的斥責震動驚奇。

en.text: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

zhSimplified.text: 他以能力搅动大海； 他借知识打伤拉哈伯，

zhTraditional.text: 他以能力攪動大海； 他藉知識打傷拉哈伯，

en.text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

zhSimplified.text: 借他的灵使天有妆饰； 他的手刺杀快蛇。

zhTraditional.text: 藉他的靈使天有妝飾； 他的手刺殺快蛇。

en.text: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，这不过是 神工作的些微； 我们所听于他的是何等细微的声音！ 他大能的雷声谁能明透呢？

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，這不過是上帝工作的些微； 我們所聽於他的是何等細微的聲音！ 他大能的雷聲誰能明透呢？
